verificationNote: 原本画像で本文・初出文字・空欄長・設問順を照合済みです。出版社の解答p.409は未提供のため、正答は文法・語法・文脈に基づく編集解答です。同じ本文の全10空欄を提出するまで、解答・解説は表示されません。

passages.cubism: Cubism, as exemplified by the influential works of Pablo Picasso and Georges Braque, is often hailed as one of the most significant modern art movements. Its subj____ were bro___ and rearr_____ in an abst____ form th__ simultaneously empha_____ multiple perspe______. Critics ar___ that th___ techniques capt____ the atmosphere of the early 20th century, including industrialization and the tensions that led up to World War I. Thus, Cubism is considered an ideal representation of the period.

questions.prompt: Question 11: complete subj____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ects → subjects。subjectsは絵画の「題材」。wereの主語なので複数形です。

questions.prompt: Question 12: complete bro___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ken → broken。were brokenは「分割された」。wereと組み合わさる過去分詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 13: complete rearr_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：anged → rearranged。were broken and rearrangedは「分割され、再配置された」。二つの過去分詞が並びます。

questions.prompt: Question 14: complete abst____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ract → abstract。an abstract formは「抽象的な形」。abstractは母音の音で始まるためanです。

questions.prompt: Question 15: complete th__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：at → that。thatはformを説明する関係代名詞。後ろの強調する働きを持つ形を述べます。

questions.prompt: Question 16: complete empha_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sized → emphasized。emphasizedは「強調した」。過去の技法を述べる関係節の動詞です。

questions.prompt: Question 17: complete perspe______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ctives → perspectives。multiple perspectivesは「複数の視点」。一つの視点に限定しないキュビズムの表現です。

questions.prompt: Question 18: complete ar___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：gue → argue。Critics argue that ...は「批評家は〜と論じる」。複数のCriticsに対応する形です。

questions.prompt: Question 19: complete th___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ese → these。these techniquesは「これらの技法」。前文の分割・再配置・複数視点を指します。

questions.prompt: Question 20: complete capt____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ured → captured。captured the atmosphereは「時代の雰囲気を捉えた」。後文のrepresentation of the periodにも対応します。
